search_files.desc: Find files and directories by NAME using glob patterns. Use when you know (part of) the name but not the location. Patterns without / match filename only; patterns with / or ** match the full relative path. For searching file CONTENTS, use grep_files instead.

params.path: Root directory to search from. Defaults to the server's current working directory.

grep_files.desc: Search file CONTENTS for a pattern. Returns matching lines with file path and line number. For finding files by NAME, use search_files instead. output_mode 'auto' (default) shows matching lines when results fit within max_results, then falls back to file-path-only when capped — use 'content' or 'files_with_matches' for predictable output. Supports Go regex (set use_regex=true for |, ., +, *, ^, $, or character classes), context lines, pagination via offset, glob filtering, and cross-line multiline patterns.

params.path: File or directory to search. Defaults to the server's current working directory.
params.pattern: Literal text or regular expression to search for. Required.
params.use_regex: Treat pattern as a Go regular expression. Required for | (alternation), . (wildcard), +, *, ^, $, and character classes (\w, \d). Default: false.
params.context_lines: Lines before and after each match to include. Default: 0. Max: 50.
params.max_results: Max matches per page (content mode). Default: 50.
params.offset: Skip the first N matches for pagination. Default: 0.
params.glob: Only search files matching this glob pattern (e.g. *.go, *.{ts,tsx}). Default: all files.
params.output_mode: "auto" (default) — adapts based on result count. "content" — always show matching lines. "files_with_matches" — only file paths. "count" — match counts per file.
params.multiline: Enable patterns that span multiple lines. Default: false.
params.max_file_size: Skip files larger than this many bytes. Default: 0 (no limit).
